display_name: AIA Khỏe Trọn Vẹn product rules and terms V012022 (MoF letter 14632/BTC-QLBH, 23 December 2021): universal life with cancer, critical illness, ICU, TPD and death benefits

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of the source's text rendering, and in short runs (terms, headings) that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it.

source.authority: NONE: private contract terms published by the insurer

scope: The whole document: preamble, Articles 1-41 (Parts I-V) and Annexes 1-7, every table as data and every cancer and critical-illness definition as a predicate. 164 coverage rows: 155 encoded (parts of some reached-and-refused or inert, said in the row), 9 inert, 0 out-of-scope, 0 deferred. Inputs: certificate figures, account values, premium history, the month's cost of insurance and interest, medical findings. Named refusals where the text does not answer (cost-of-insurance rates, a negative benefit or refund, Article 12(c), Article 27 interest, Article 40 adjustment, unlisted dangerous activities). See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: 'Khách hàng' (policyowner and/or insured): Part II rights read as the policyowner's.
forks.F2: Age in completed years; 'đạt N tuổi' is the N-th birthday; 29 February birthdays reached on 28 February.
forks.F3: A 29 February effective date has its anniversary on the last day of February.
forks.F5: A period 'within N days/months from day D' excludes D and ends on D+N inclusive; 'after 2 years' is strictly after.
forks.F6: 'The next policy anniversary' after a birthday on an anniversary is a year later.
forks.F7: ICU days are the consecutive days the hospital record counts (an input).
forks.F8: TPD values and the age limb are taken at the date of the insured event.
forks.F10: Annex 4 issue age is the age in completed years on the effective date.
forks.F11: Article 23(c)(i): day 90 is inside the waiting period.
forks.F12: Annex 2: the top-up initial charge is 0% in every premium year.
forks.F13: Article 21(a)(ii): from year 5, no grace period runs until the account value reaches zero (refused where asked).
forks.F14: The crediting rate is annual; a month's interest is an input.
forks.F15: The cancer-screening support is not deducted from the main benefit formula.
forks.F16: No aggregate cap on early-stage advances; each paid in full; termination at >=100%.
forks.F17: The 500 million ICU cap is across all the insured's contracts with the Company.
forks.F18: Article 5 conditions run over the term up to the payment date.
forks.F19: Loyalty bonus valued on the last day of the year, allocated at the anniversary.
forks.F20: Article 9: basic premiums due so far in years 1-4 paid in full.
forks.F21: Article 22: withdrawals are taken before the monthly deduction.
forks.F22: Article 23(a): a beneficiary's fraud gives the innocent shares, not the account value.
forks.F23: Article 26(b)(ii): the impairment certificate is asked only of TPD claims.
forks.F24: Article 29: a first premium over 100 million is refunded instead of paying the benefit.
forks.F25: Article 12(c): the reduced sum insured is not determined (refused).
forks.F26: Article 13(c): 'the nearest anniversary' is the first after approval.
forks.F27: Article 25: an ICU claim's 12 months run from the start of treatment.
forks.F28: Article 27: how late interest accrues is not determined (refused).
forks.L1-L13: LAW forks against Law 08/2022/QH15 (aid): contra proferentem, claim period tolling, payment period, free look, Art 37(4) deduction, grace and reinstatement, statutory exclusions, transfer consent, dispute modes, beneficiary shares, misstatement, payment after termination, the Law's applicability. See NOTES.md section 3.

findings: 28 findings (X1-X22, X24-X26, X29-X31) in NOTES.md section 4; 15 demonstrated by passing assertions (X2-X6, X8, X14, X15, X18, X21, X22, X24-X26, X29), the rest reading only. 41 forks: F1-F28 and LAW forks L1-L13.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests modules was written by the same session that wrote the rules (worked by hand from the source text; the table tests and the Annex 6-7 tests are generated by scripts from the raw text and from a hand-written specification).
